title: 9，都二十一世纪了，我们为什么还像一战时那样战斗？！
slug: 人在俄乌当佣兵杀敌就能爆属性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

沈飞把失而复得的干袜子重新塞进背包最里面，又用破布裹了一层，然后背起包，拿起自动步枪，弯着腰朝不远处的双人射击坑走去。

所谓射击坑，

其实就是从主壕沟旁边斜着挖出去的一小段浅坑。

前面用沙袋跟烂木板和冻硬的泥块垒出一个低矮的胸墙，中间留着一道狭窄的射击口。

射击口很小，枪架上去之后，人只能透过一条黑漆漆的缝往外看。

坑底全是泥水，旁边还挖了一条浅浅的排水沟，但看起来已经被烂泥堵了一半。

沈飞趴进去的时候，膝盖刚碰到地面，就感觉一股冷意。

他调整了一下枪口，确保没有伸出射击口太多。

训练营里的老兵说过，枪口伸出去太长，夜里会露轮廓，白天会反光，别人一眼就能知道这里趴着人。

这种细节很小。

但在这里，小细节往往决定一个人会不会突然脑袋开花。

穆萨很快也钻了进来。

他的动作比沈飞粗糙得多，刚趴下就把泥水压得哗啦一声。

沈飞皱眉，低声道：“小点声。”

穆萨看了他一眼，没反驳，只是把身体压低了一点。

两人趴在射击坑里，前方三百米外，是被炮火炸烂的林带。

黑暗里，断树若隐若现，看起来非常吓人。

远处偶尔有火光闪一下，照亮几秒钟，又很快重新陷入黑暗。

沈飞眼睛盯着前方，心里还在想着刚才的事。

相比起动刀，他更喜欢朋友多多的，敌人少少的，尽量不搞什么矛盾。

可问题是，

身为这段壕沟里唯一的黄种人，他注定很难融入毛熊重刑犯的圈子。

如果再不动手，今天丢的是袜子，明天丢的可能就是弹匣，食物，水壶，甚至是命。

只是很可惜，堑壕里的条件实在不允许，要不然如果直接杀了伊万的话，立威的效果会更好。

袜子是不是他偷的，其实不重要。

主要是这帮毛子，不把他们打服，早晚还要生事。

穆萨趴在旁边，忽然低声说道，“你刚才很帅。”

沈飞目视前方，头也不回的说：“注意盯着所有人的动向，防止被人报复。”

“好。”穆萨干脆的答应了下来。

两人都很紧张，

毕竟是第一次真正趴在前线射击坑里，前面可能有敌人，头顶可能有无人机，后面还有督战队。

这种情况，很难不紧张。

他们都想通过聊天的方式，缓解一下身体跟心理的不适感，可是两个人实在找不到什么共同话题。

国家不同，肤色不同，经历不同，性格更不同....

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Shen Fei stuffed the lost dry socks back into the innermost part of his backpack and wrapped them in rags. Then he shouldered the bag, picked up the automatic rifle, and bent over and walked towards the two-person shooting pit not far away.

The so-called shooting pit,

In fact, it is a small shallow pit dug diagonally from the side of the main trench.

In front, sandbags, rotten boards and frozen mud were used to build a low parapet, with a narrow shooting opening in the middle.

The shooting port is very small. After the gun is mounted, one can only look out through a dark gap.

The bottom of the pit was full of mud and water, and a shallow drainage ditch was dug next to it, but it seemed to be half blocked by mud.

When Shen Fei lay down, he felt a chill as soon as his knees touched the ground.

He adjusted the muzzle of the gun, making sure it didn't stick out too far.

Veterans in the training camp said that if the muzzle of the gun extends too far, its outline will be revealed at night and reflected during the day, and others will know at a glance that there is someone lying there.

This kind of detail is small.

But here, small details often determine whether a person will suddenly have a brain blossom.

Musa soon got in too.

His movements were much rougher than Shen Fei's, and as soon as he lay down, the mud and water made a splash.

Shen Fei frowned and whispered: "Keep your voice down."

Musa glanced at him and didn't refute, just lowered his body a little.

The two of them were lying in the shooting pit. Three hundred meters in front of them was a forest belt that was destroyed by artillery fire.

In the darkness, broken trees loomed, looking very scary.

Occasionally a fire flashed in the distance, illuminating it for a few seconds and then quickly falling back into darkness.

Shen Fei stared ahead, still thinking about what happened just now.

Rather than wielding a knife, he prefers to have many friends and few enemies, and try not to cause any conflicts.

But the problem is,

As the only yellow man in this trench, he was destined to find it difficult to integrate into the circle of Mao Xiong felons.

If you don't take action, what you lose today is your socks, and tomorrow you may lose your magazine, food, water bottle, or even your life.

It's just a pity that the conditions in the trench really don't allow it, otherwise if Ivan is killed directly, the effect of establishing prestige will be better.

It doesn't really matter whether he stole the socks or not.

Mainly because of these idiots, if we don't defeat them, they will cause trouble sooner or later.

Musa lay beside him and suddenly whispered, "You were so handsome just now."

Shen Fei looked forward and said without looking back: "Pay attention to everyone's movements to prevent retaliation."

"Okay." Musa agreed simply.

Both of them were very nervous;

After all, this was the first time I was really lying in a frontline shooting pit. There might be enemies in front of me, drones above my head, and a supervising team behind me.

In this situation, it's hard not to be nervous.

They all wanted to relieve their physical and mental discomfort through chatting, but they couldn't find anything in common.

Different countries, different skin colors, different experiences, even different personalities...
